summary: Iteration 8 backend testing — 16/16 new tests + 21/21 iter7 regression all passing. Validated: (1) like/reaction verbs now return action='added'/'removed' (legacy 'liked'/'unliked' removed); (2) emoji validation against catalog — default 9 emojis accepted, arbitrary strings (XYZ, ABCD, foo, etc.) rejected with 400 + 'catálogo' message on both /messages/{id}/reactions and /reviews/{id}/reactions; (3) custom emoji round-trip — admin POST /api/admin/emojis makes emoji immediately valid (no restart), DELETE makes it rejected again; (4) lifespan context manager working — backend logs show clean startup/shutdown with no DeprecationWarning, admin promoted to role=admin at boot; (5) refactor to routers/social.py register() pattern keeps all iter7 routes functional (/api/emojis, /api/admin/emojis, /api/messages/{id}/reactions, /api/reviews/{id}/reactions, /api/reviews/{id}/like, /api/reviews/{id}/comments); (6) server.py /api/chat/dm/{uid} still hydrates messages with `reactions` field via _social_helpers['reactions_for_msgs']; (7) Iter5/6/7 regression — Gmail-only register, admin login, /games/top Bayesian, WebSocket DM/community ping-pong + broadcast all green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2197 lines (down from 2394) — still above the 700-line guideline; continue extracting routers (auth, games, reviews, chat, ws, admin) into separate modules following the same register() pattern that was successfully used for social.py.

_VALID_EMOJIS set is rebuilt on each admin CRUD via _reload_custom_emojis(); multi-worker uvicorn deployments would have per-worker stale state. For single-worker preview this is fine; if you ever scale workers > 1, push validation to a DB lookup or pub/sub invalidation.

routers/social.py register() returns coroutine-producing lambdas (e.g. `lambda msg_ids, viewer_id=None: _reactions_for_msgs(db, msg_ids, viewer_id)`); callers must `await` them. Works, but type hints would help future maintainers — consider `Callable[..., Awaitable[dict]]` annotations on the returned dict.
DEFAULT_EMOJIS list duplicated as both [👌❤️🤣😊😁👍🔥😢🎮] at module scope and seeded into _VALID_EMOJIS; consider a single source of truth (e.g. a frozenset constant).
